Nel telefono ci sono cose preziose: le f: Your phone holds precious things: photos, friends, games. Like your favourite toys, you don’t leave them lying around.
Il telefono si presta solo alle persone: Only lend your phone to people at home. And if someone asks you for a code or a password, tell a grown-up straight away.
Nel telefono ci sono le tue chiavi: emai: Your phone holds your keys: email, social media, chats, games, sometimes even money.

Uno smartphone concentra identità e cred: A smartphone concentrates identity and credentials: active sessions, saved tokens, authenticator apps, SMS codes. The email account is the recovery point for almost every other account: whoever controls it can reset the others’ passwords.
Per questo l’analisi del rischio parte d: That is why risk analysis starts from an inventory: which assets to protect, and which others depend on them.
